title: Pink town
content: I've always been a vivid dreamer and I visit multiple places each night but one stands out to me and it happens only every couple of years. It's a small town square, it's evening time and the sky is pink making the town look pink. It's a small town square with a red brick road in an elongated U shape and there's a few buildings around the outside of the road and in the middle of the U is a grass patch. For some reason nobody else is there, and I can't enter the buildings. It's always short, but it has a pleasant feeling. Please tell me I'm not alone
